2:203.text: And remember Allâh during the appointed Days.
But whosoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sin on him and whosoever stays on, there is no sin on him, if his aim is to do good and obey Allâh
, and know that you will surely be gathered unto Him.

2:204.text: And of mankind there is he whose speech may please you
, in this worldly life, and he calls Allâh to witness as to that which is in his heart, yet he is the most quarrelsome of the opponents.

2:205.text: , his effort in the land is to make mischief therein and to destroy the crops and the cattle, and Allâh likes not mischief.

2:206.text: And when it is said to him, "Fear Allâh", he is led by arrogance to
crime. So enough for him is Hell, and worst indeed is that place to rest!

2:207.text: And of mankind is he who would sell himself, seeking the Pleasure of Allâh. And Allâh is full of Kindness to

2:208.text: O you who believe! Enter perfectly in Islâm
(by obeying all the rules and regulations of the Islâmic religion)
and follow not the footsteps of Shaitan
. Verily! He is to you a plain enemy.

2:209.text: Then if you slide back after the clear signs
(Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and this Qur’ân, and Islâm)
have come to you, then know that Allâh is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

2:210.text: Do they then wait for anything other than that Allâh should come to them in the shadows of the clouds and the angels?
the case would be already judged. And to Allâh return all matters
